entities.name: Phaskin
entities.description: A Shift Commander of the Tenth Section in 9999 Z.C., superior to Agrus Kos, killed and replaced by a lupul.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Lieutenant under Phaskin, wounded in the assassination attempt on Saint Bayul.

entities.name: Sulli Valenco
entities.description: Ninth Section Commander Phaskin was to replace.

entities.name: Stanslov
entities.description: Lieutenant given Kos's case, later consumed by the false Phaskin.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: Helped Kos escape and destroyed the false Phaskin.

entities.name: Fonn
entities.description: Led back to the mortuary by Kos, took Bayul's green gem.

entities.name: Lupul
entities.description: Shapeshifting creature that killed and replaced the real Phaskin.

events.summary: After Kos is wounded, Phaskin orders him to hand his case to Stanslov and relieves him of duty when he objects.
With Feather's help Kos escapes the infirmary and leads Fonn to the Tenth Leaguehall mortuary.
When Fonn takes Bayul's green gem, the false Phaskin reveals himself and consumes Stanslov.
events.quote: He revealed himself and consumed Lieutenant
The false Phaskin was destroyed by Feather almost immediately after.

relations.quote: The false Phaskin was destroyed by Feather almost immediately after.
